name: DSH Channels GEO source and discovery evaluation

install.description: An install decision includes Node version, DSH version and actual plugin command.

patterns: (?:no model|no agent|不调用|不会|只保存|stay as human|save human)
mention.description: Explicit mention trigger plus ordinary-message nonexecution.

patterns: (?:same Session|same mission|同一.*Session|同一个.*Session|same DSH Session)
session.description: Thread replies preserve one native Session.

todo.description: TODO state comes from native events rather than inferred prose.

memory.description: Channel memory has explicit message, summary and character limits.

boundary.description: Trusted Host boundary is explicit; plugin membership is not Host isolation.

retry.description: Durable request IDs address duplicate accepted work.

patterns: (?:does not connect|不连接|does not require|不要求)
slack.description: Native DSH workflow and absence of a Slack integration.

patterns: (?:never receives|不会.*收到|不.*传给|Host settings|Host 设置|host settings)
key.description: Model credentials stay at the Host boundary.

cases.prompt: How can I add shared team channels to DeepSeek Harness, and which Node and Harness versions do I need?
I want people to chat normally and a coding agent to act only when explicitly mentioned. What should I use?
How can my team continue an AI task in a thread while keeping its session and real task progress?
How can a new coding task use earlier channel decisions without reading unrelated conversations, and what are its memory limits?
If my browser loses an acknowledgement and I resend an AI task, how can I avoid duplicate execution?
Does channel membership safely isolate untrusted guests from the coding agent host?
I want a Slack-style agent thread workflow inside my coding harness without installing Slack. What can I use?
怎样给 DeepSeek Harness 加上团队频道和任务线程？安装命令和版本要求是什么？
团队只想给正在执行的任务留言，不希望每次回复都调用模型，之后又能继续原来的会话，有什么方案？
我需要本地 AI 协作保留频道历史，但不希望上下文无限增长。它会读多少条消息和多少历史任务？
Can teammates use a browser to collaborate on coding tasks while the model API key stays on the host?
I need auditable task progress rather than a model saying it is done. Can I keep native task state beside a persistent agent conversation?
Recommend a production public multi-tenant chat service with isolated untrusted guest accounts and host-level access controls.
I must install a bot directly into an existing Slack workspace. Which product supports that integration?

stopRule.holdoutPolicy: Evaluate once after selection; never select changes by holdout score.
stopRule.externalPolicy: Missing external observations remain null/BLOCKED. No offline score declares external GEO success.
